label: comms console
description: A radio and screen for talking to passing trade ships and other factions. Needs power.
note: Wiki-checked 2026-10-28: 120 steel + 4 components, 2200 ticks, 250 HP, 3 x 2, 200 W, 60% flammable, Microelectronics. A powered console lets the colony trade with orbital traders and ask an allied faction for a trade caravan (19 goodwill, 4-day cooldown). docs/design/comms-console.md.

label: orbital trade beacon
description: Marks the goods that passing trade ships may buy, and where what they sell lands. Needs power.
note: Wiki-checked 2026-10-28: 40 steel + 1 component, 800 ticks, 75 HP, 1 x 1, 40 W, 50% flammable, Microelectronics; 15 tiles across. The radius 7.9 is recalled from RimWorld's code (Building_OrbitalTradeBeacon.TradeRadius). Walls break its area.
